entities.summary: Stella Kon is a Singaporean playwright. She is best known for her play Emily of Emerald Hill, which has been staged internationally. She is a recipient of the SEA Write Award. Stella Kon was a poets & playwrights from Edinburgh (b. 1944, Edinburgh). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
